# Maintained document quality

## Scope

Durable guidance must identify its reader task, the authority for each claim,
and the route a reader uses before relying on it.

## Apply the rule

Trace every required decision from the reader's starting point. Keep the
current explanation coherent and validate the final reading route separately
from factual correctness.

The [legacy-format note](knowledge-only.md) is related background, not a route
that selects another Knowledge leaf for an installed user task.
